contract_id: Stage 3 H6.1 Spray Process Tolerance Contract

classification.scope: simulation/research acceptance constraints for surface-constrained spray trajectory planning

semantic_definitions.standoff: Euclidean distance from the FK TCP position to the declared surface point in the declared reference frame; signed error is actual_standoff_m - nominal_standoff_m and absolute error is its absolute value.
semantic_definitions.surface_normal_angular_deviation: The angle between the actual spray direction and the expected surface-normal-aligned spray direction at the same dense Spray-ON waypoint.
semantic_definitions.actual_spray_direction: The normalized TCP local +Z axis expressed in the declared reference frame by the FK TCP orientation.
semantic_definitions.expected_spray_direction: The frozen H6 spray_direction_unit, defined as the unit vector from TCP/nozzle toward the surface.
semantic_definitions.tcp_position_error: Euclidean distance between the frozen commanded TCP position and the FK TCP position.
semantic_definitions.tcp_orientation_error: Shortest rotation angle between the frozen commanded TCP orientation and the FK TCP orientation, expressed in degrees.
semantic_definitions.spray_off: Spray-OFF transfer waypoints are excluded from Spray-ON process tolerance acceptance but remain subject to native IK, joint-limit, FK, collision-free, and adaptive discrete interpolation checks.

surface_normal_convention.orientation: H2-oriented normal carried through the frozen H4.5 fixture transform

spray_direction_convention.actual_axis: TCP local +Z expressed in base_link by FK

acceptance_rules.scope: all dense Spray-ON waypoints; no endpoint-only substitution

provenance.authority: Stage 3 H6.1 project-defined research/simulation acceptance contract
provenance.values_source: Stage 3 H6.1 task specification; conservative values are declared before recertification and are not inferred from H6 maximum errors
provenance.historical_contract_status: No prior H6-authoritative formal spray-process tolerance was found in the read-only audit

hashing.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON, recursively sorted object keys, compact separators, ensure_ascii=true, with top-level contract_sha256 set to null
